patches.retirement_condition: Upstream equivalent plus replay after removal, affected backend fixtures and feature-off controls; no removal is authorized by this triage.

patches.rationale: Native 5.3 Gaussian primary/shadow intersections need the same existence intervals as point geometry before stochastic opacity; this extends 0005 to a new traversal path.
patches.next_action: Maintain jointly with 0005; propose only with a generic lifetime API and Gaussian time-boundary/opacity feature-off controls.
patches.retirement_condition: Upstream equivalent plus replay after removal, affected backend fixtures and feature-off controls; no removal is authorized by this triage.

patches.rationale: The local output-driver sample accessor reports generation progress to Houdini. Temporal denoising resets the current pixel accumulation while the generation continues rendering.
patches.next_action: Keep the cumulative output counter paired with the temporal DLSS worker regression and the current-buffer pixel normalization path.
patches.retirement_condition: Any byte change or upstream rebase expires this grant. Return through the full gate. Retire against a qualified upstream API or record a new explicit grant for this patch, hash and base.

patches.rationale: The mesh-union normal stride retained its pre-tessellation primitive count while the generic sampled-attribute count was refreshed. This freezes moving authored normals during linear-subdivision displacement.
patches.next_action: Propose refreshing both primitive counts after tessellation with authored-normal motion and retessellation coverage, retaining sampled generic attributes and global geometry offsets.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire once upstream refreshes the mesh-union primitive count after tessellation and CPU and OptiX sampled displacement plus named-attribute motion fixtures pass without the patch.

patches.rationale: Large instanced scenes repeatedly scan every object against every volume-object bound during flag updates. A conservative spatial broad phase avoids this quadratic search while exact leaves retain the existing rounded center/size predicate.
patches.next_action: Extract the generic host overlap index and exact linear-oracle reproducer independently of Houdini, qualify repeated flag passes and CPU/OptiX images, then request upstream review separately; no external submission is authorized here.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire once upstream supplies an equivalent exact object-volume overlap broad phase and removing this patch passes independent successor replay, rounded/nonfinite overlap and flag-state contracts, plus affected CPU/OptiX image controls.

patches.rationale: A combined primitive bitmask sent static triangles through the motion normal reader, producing out-of-bounds reads and incorrect normal-mapped shading.
patches.next_action: Qualify the exact primitive-type check on static and animated CPU/OptiX meshes. Keep the correction local to our sampled-shutter normal-map extension.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire with the parent extension or an upstream implementation that passes neutral normal-map and motion-normal parity.

patches.rationale: Reject missing owner mappings before range uploads and use full-copy fallback for per-device allocations.
patches.next_action: Keep local; validate the focused regression and prepare a stock reproducer before proposing the parent API upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire with the parent local API or an upstream replacement that passes the same fault and output contracts.

patches.rationale: Expose current accumulation samples separately from cumulative temporal output progress to correctly recover raw Sample Count.
patches.next_action: Keep local; validate the focused regression and prepare a stock reproducer before proposing the parent API upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire with the parent local API or an upstream replacement that passes the same fault and output contracts.

patches.rationale: Match viewport normalization when DLSS output and sample-count input resolutions differ.
patches.next_action: Keep local; validate upscaled sample-count output on one and two GPUs before any upstream proposal.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream output readback passes the same sample-count, alpha and energy regression.

patches.rationale: Upload every moving instance motion transform with one host-to-device copy per OptiX top-level build instead of one synchronous copy and context switch per object.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure the Threads frame-change scene on one and two GPUs, then prepare a stock Cycles many-moving-instances reproducer before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream OptiX build_bvh batches motion transform uploads and the motion-blur instancing fixtures pass on OptiX.

patches.rationale: Evaluate per-object bounds in parallel; each object writes only its own bounds, so motion-blur sampled bounds stay bit-identical while no longer serial.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure the compute-bounds stage with many moving instances and prepare a stock Cycles timing reproducer before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream computes object bounds in parallel with identical bounds and the motion-blur fixtures pass on CPU and OptiX.

patches.rationale: Prepare OptiX instance descriptions and decomposed motion transforms with parallel_for after assigning slots and offsets in object order; contents are unchanged.
patches.next_action: Keep local together with 0092; prepare a stock Cycles many-moving-instances timing reproducer before proposing both upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream prepares OptiX top-level instances in parallel and the motion-blur instancing fixtures pass on OptiX.

patches.rationale: Skip the per-object conversion, table writes and upload of object attributes when a content check proves the full rebuild would reproduce them; object attributes are not sockets, so no update flag can certify them.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure the Threads frame-change attribute stage on one and two GPUs and prepare a stock Cycles many-instances-with-object-attributes timing reproducer before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream avoids rebuilding unchanged object attributes on transform-only updates and the object attribute fixtures pass on CPU and OptiX.

patches.rationale: The per-object attribute map entries and kernel object attribute offsets were written serially on every geometry update; each object writes only its own slots, so the loops run in parallel with identical results.
patches.next_action: Keep local together with 0095; measure the attribute stage with many instances on one and two GPUs and prepare a stock Cycles timing reproducer before proposing both upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream writes object attribute maps and offsets in parallel and the object attribute fixtures pass on CPU and OptiX.

patches.rationale: Edge factor patch evaluations in the serial DiagSplit pass dominated tessellation of large subdivided meshes; precomputing them in parallel and reusing only exact argument matches keeps the split identical.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure tessellation of 200,000 and 2 million quads on CPU and OptiX and prepare a stock Cycles subdivision timing reproducer before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream splits subdivision patches in parallel with identical results and the subdivision fixtures pass on CPU and OptiX.

patches.rationale: Per-edge node allocations and bucket walks of the unordered_set dominated the ordered subdivision split; an open addressing table with the same vertex-pair identity keeps results identical.
patches.next_action: Keep local together with 0097; measure tessellation of 200,000 and 2 million quads and prepare a stock Cycles subdivision timing reproducer before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream stores split edges without per-edge allocations and the subdivision fixtures pass on CPU and OptiX.

patches.rationale: Filling the OptiX curve build input was serial and linear in the segment count, about half a second per GPU for a million ribbon curves.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure the object BVH stage for 1M and 5M ribbon, thick and linear curves on one and two GPUs and prepare a stock Cycles curve timing reproducer before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream fills the OptiX curve build input in parallel with identical arrays and the curve fixtures pass on OptiX.

patches.rationale: Adding or removing instances rebuilt all object attribute requests, layout and values serially through per-object attribute sets, and the attribute map serialised on the shader manager lock.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure Threads frame changes with dying particles on one and two GPUs and prepare a stock Cycles many-instances-with-object-attributes reproducer with changing counts before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream updates object attribute tables without per-object attribute sets on instance count changes and the object attribute fixtures pass on CPU and OptiX.

patches.rationale: The curve build input was recomputed per GPU although it is identical; computing it once keeps the work independent of the GPU count and guarantees every device builds from the same input.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure the object BVH stage for ribbon, thick and linear curves on one and two GPUs and decide with upstream whether multi-device builds should share host build data.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream shares host build input between sub-devices of a multi-device BVH build and the curve fixtures pass on OptiX with two GPUs.

patches.rationale: One static lock made all bottom level builds of all GPUs strictly serial although each device has its own memory, stream and OptiX context.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure 20,000 and 2,000 objects, Threads and 1M curves on one and two GPUs and prepare a stock Cycles many-objects multi-GPU timing reproducer before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream serialises OptiX acceleration builds per device and the object and curve fixtures pass on OptiX with two GPUs.

patches.rationale: Per-build allocation and release of temporary build memory cost two driver calls per acceleration structure, which dominates many small builds.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure 20,000 and 2,000 objects on one and two GPUs and prepare a stock Cycles many-objects timing reproducer before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream reuses temporary OptiX build memory between builds and the object and curve fixtures pass on OptiX.

patches.rationale: A kept temporary buffer must not raise the device memory peak: large ones are not reused and none survives into the attribute upload.
patches.next_action: Keep local together with 0103; measure device memory peaks for 5M ribbon curves and large meshes on one and two GPUs before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire together with 0103 when upstream reuses temporary OptiX build memory between builds without raising the device memory peak.

patches.rationale: Sub-devices of one multi-device build are independent, so building them one after the other only added the second device's time to every large or scene level build.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure Threads scene level builds, 5M curves and many objects on two GPUs and prepare a stock Cycles multi-GPU timing reproducer before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream builds multi-device acceleration structures on parallel sub-devices and the object and curve fixtures pass on OptiX with two GPUs.

patches.rationale: Light objects are in no acceleration structure, yet every light move rebuilt the scene structure and recomputed bounds and attributes.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure light moves on large instanced scenes on one and two GPUs before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream stops tagging the geometry manager for changes of light objects.

patches.rationale: Every attribute update packed all curve keys into a new array even when the table did not copy them, about 35 ms per edit with 1M curves.
patches.next_action: Keep local; propose upstream together with a small reproducer measuring a light edit with many static curves.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream builds the combined position and radius array only for modified attributes.

patches.rationale: A light or object move rewrote and copied the whole object table, about 55 ms per edit with 500,000 instanced objects.
patches.next_action: Keep local; measure light and object moves on large instanced scenes on one and two GPUs before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream writes and uploads only the modified entries of the object table.

patches.rationale: A serial loop over all objects cost about 26 ms on every scene update of a 500,000 object scene, including light strength and camera edits.
patches.next_action: Keep local; propose upstream with a many-object reproducer once measured on one and two GPUs.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream computes kernel features without a serial loop over every object on each update.

patches.rationale: Host preparation of every top level instance costs about 130 ms per object move on large instanced scenes while the build itself takes a few milliseconds.
patches.next_action: Keep while the OptiX top level build is rebuilt from host instance data on every object edit.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream Cycles keeps and updates its top level instance buffers between builds.

patches.rationale: The tangents timer was declared at function scope and counted the scene BVH, bounds and attribute stages a second time.
patches.next_action: Keep while the geometry update statistics are used to profile interactive updates.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream Cycles scopes the tessellation and tangents timer to its loop.

patches.rationale: Each light edit walked all objects several times in the light manager, about 10-20 ms per edit on 380k objects.
patches.next_action: Keep while the light manager finds lights by walking scene objects.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream Cycles keeps a list of light objects in the scene or light manager.

patches.rationale: Each single object or light edit on 380k instances spent 21-33 ms walking and copying every object flag.
patches.next_action: Keep while the object flags pass walks every object on each object update.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream Cycles updates object flags incrementally.

patches.rationale: Large pose moves rewrote the whole object table, flags and offsets; scattered partial uploads paid one copy per run.
patches.next_action: Keep while the object table is written and uploaded from host mirrors per update.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream Cycles updates its object table incrementally with batched uploads.

patches.rationale: Pose-only edits on large instanced scenes spent 20-45 ms rebuilding attribute requests, maps and offsets that could not change.
patches.next_action: Keep while every geometry update rebuilds the attribute requests, map and offsets from all objects.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream Cycles tracks attribute table inputs and updates them incrementally.

patches.rationale: Scattered moves of thousands of blurred instances issued one synchronous copy per motion transform run in the top level stage.
patches.next_action: Keep while the incremental top level uploads motion transforms from its host copy.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire together with the incremental top level (0110) or when uploads are batched by the device.

patches.rationale: Attribute-only edits of instances are not object modifications, so the kept path left their device values stale.
patches.next_action: Keep together with 0115 while object attribute values are not tracked as node sockets.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire with 0115, or when object attribute edits mark the object modified.

patches.rationale: The OptiX build temporary regression guard needs per-GPU whole-update peaks and actual temporary sizes that the lifetime peak cannot give.
patches.next_action: Keep while the integration checks device memory per update and per physical GPU.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream Cycles exposes per-update per-device memory statistics.

patches.rationale: A progressive resize changes camera matrices. Marking every socket dirtied unchanged iris and shutter tables and recopied the shared lookup buffer.
patches.next_action: Retain for progressive IPR and isolate a stock Cycles reproducer for the shutter table before proposing the correction.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream recomputes resized camera matrices without invalidating unchanged authored lookup tables and the regression passes.

patches.rationale: Generic range requests can contain stale host bytes outside the requested offsets. An implicit full copy also makes light-tree partial upload statistics disagree with dispatch.
patches.next_action: Retain exact ranges by default and explicit measured whole-host fallback only for known complete object and OptiX mirrors. Review production CPU, CUDA/OptiX and multi-device ownership and byte evidence before proposing upstream.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire when upstream Cycles exposes an exact bounded range contract and an explicit cost-based full-copy policy for complete mirrors, with the same byte-transfer and fault checks.

retired_patches.return_condition: Only as a complete exact ramps-and-curves pair under one kernel mechanism, ADR and kernel-surface budget.

retired_patches.reason: K33 selects Blender-equivalent 257-entry host-baked ramp and curve tables into stock Cycles nodes.
retired_patches.return_condition: Only as a complete exact ramps-and-curves pair under one kernel mechanism, ADR and kernel-surface budget.

retired_patches.return_condition: Only under a new explicit owner decision supported by resource resolution, working-linear/output/viewer parity and independent-process session-isolation evidence.

retired_patches.return_condition: Only under a new explicit owner decision supported by resource resolution, working-linear/output/viewer parity and independent-process session-isolation evidence.
